blocks.text: «Note that each component of a compound numeral is declined separately.» On the accusative: «The word **один** follows this rule even when it appears at the end of a compound numeral: **Я вижу двадцать одного студента**.» «However, **два** (**две**), **три**, **четыре** etc. appearing at the end of the compound numerals do not follow the above pattern in the Accusative case. Their Accusative (both animate and inanimate) is usually the same as the Nominative.»
DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 71, pp. 32–34. · Every form on this page is the OpenCorpora dictionary's own (CC BY-SA 4.0), put together by the rules quoted above.

Real sentences: from the library's public-domain books (author and title above each), and from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), shown with their translation. The numeral is blanked; type it in the form the sentence needs. ё and е are both accepted.

exercises.q: Может ли быть, чтобы девушка ___ (22, gen.) лет никогда не видела эротических снов?

exercises.why: **тридцать → тридцатью** (instr.: за + instrumental). Numerals decline like adjectives in the plural; every part of a compound numeral declines.

exercises.q: Он ___ (25, gen.) рублей, конечно, не дороже.
exercises.why: **двадцать → двадцати** (gen.: agrees with рублей (genitive plural)). Numerals decline like adjectives in the plural; every part of a compound numeral declines.

whys.comp: «Note that each component of a compound numeral is declined separately.» On the accusative: «The word один follows this rule even when it appears at the end of a compound numeral: Я вижу двадцать одного студента.» «However, два (две), три, четыре etc. appearing at the end of the compound numerals do not follow the above pattern in the Accusative case. Their Accusative (both animate and inanimate) is usually the same as the Nominative.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 71, pp. 32–34.

ctxs.comp: «Note that each component of a compound numeral is declined separately.»
